description: Unavailable on Cloudflare Workers. Wo Mail requires IMAP/SMTP, so run this provider from the Node.js runtime.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.description: The full Wo Mail mailbox address to connect, such as user@wo.cn.

fields.label: Authorization Code or Password
fields.description: The Wo Mail mailbox authorization code or application password after enabling IMAP/SMTP. Prefer a revocable authorization code over the web login password.
